decisions.reason: The integral definition and its nonnegative conventional domain are sound; “the finite evaluator below” is an unbound local reference. Removed that clause without changing any integral, domain, or Gamma convention.

G is explicitly the Hermitian Gram pairing C(f_phi,psi,f_rho,sigma) of pair densities, so its first density is conjugated. Thus its x factor is phi times conjugate(psi), exactly as the judge expands; no formula instead declares G linear in psi. “Bras are conjugated” applies to the explicit bra in S,T,V and to the density bra in C. The owning contract expressly requires the additional first-density conjugation; the PSD screening theorem and complex contraction formulas use that same convention. Replacing G by a bilinear density form would destroy the intended positive diagonal convention.

F7 omitted local Riemann integrability and proper compact-truncation substitution hypotheses. The actual uses are nonzero linear scalings and reflection, with continuous derivatives and polynomial-Gaussian integrands, so all omitted conditions hold. Restored the hypotheses and verified them at the uses; the factorial moments, absolute integrability, and repeated DCT parameter-derivative proof remain valid without a Statement change.

F5 omitted the supplier’s local integrability and proper compact-truncation hypotheses. The inverse-square-root substitution for T>0 and the square map for Gamma(1/2) are smooth on positive compact truncations; the zero endpoint has exponent m-1/2>-1, and the Gaussian transformed integral converges at infinity. Restored F5 and verified each endpoint and truncation explicitly. All Boys identities and their stated domains are unchanged.

F4 wrongly inferred finite rounding error from finiteness of one stored endpoint: overflow may saturate that endpoint while retaining infinite error. Restated F4 with the exact endpoint in finite range and explicit overflow caveat. The Statement already excludes every overflowing recurrence step; both outward endpoints being finite forces the exact interval endpoints into range. The affine radius estimates and their finite iteration are unchanged.

Step 1.1 stated uniform derivative domination using only an exponent lower bound, which fails for unbounded exponents because center/spatial derivatives have coefficients growing in a. The Statement and Given already require a compact positive exponent set. Rewrote the proof with a0<=a<=a1 and bounded polynomial coefficients, and explicitly bounded the exponential by exp(a0 R²)exp(-a0|x|²/2). The compact-domain theorem and all integral claims are unchanged.

The abstract energy definition admits arbitrary real four-tensors, for which positive Coulomb diagonals cannot bound off-diagonal entries. With W11=W22=1, G1111=G2222=0 and G1122=100, the single omitted energy term is 50 while the proposed bound is zero. Explicitly required G_abcd=G(phi_a,phi_b;phi_c,phi_d) in the real functional. The Gram positivity proof, Cauchy–Schwarz including zero diagonals, and weighted finite reindexing now prove the claimed specialization.

The Gamma procedure requires a positive exact rational tolerance, whereas the Boys parent admits an arbitrary positive tolerance and passed epsilon_a/2^(k+2). The call was outside the supplier interface for irrational epsilon_a. Repaired it by a charged halving loop from q=1 until rational q<=epsilon_a, then passing q/2^(k+2). This preserves every parent input and gives a child tolerance no larger than the original target; all final parent accuracy tests remain mandatory and caps still return inconclusive.

The separate result thm-finite-gaussian-integral-evaluator-soundness-and-screening-error exists on the owning page and depends on this algorithm. Its steps 1.1–2.1 prove recurrence cutoff availability, exact formula and complex coefficient compatibility, and interval containment; step 1.2 proves uniform weighted screening; step 3.1 applies the explicit tensor energy/gradient estimates over C,D boxes; step 4.1 proves shared-counter termination. The algorithm’s real-coefficient energy branch computes precisely the Gaussian Coulomb tensor required by the repaired screening theorem. The added rational Gamma-tolerance construction lies inside its Boys child and preserves its full interface. No algorithm edit is needed.

An only-if skip guard permits skipping eligible blocks but does not force either skip, so it does not imply a reported total of 0.8 tau. Moreover actual outward accumulation can increase this exact sum. Specified the permitted policy that takes each eligible skip, proved the two-then-third exact comparisons, and qualified the exact reported number by exact representability for the actual evaluator (tau=5, bounds=2 is a concrete witness). The general point that all skipped bounds accumulate is preserved.
